name: B's Supermarket (Shop Floor)
description: A small but well-stocked supermarket. Shelves line the walls with groceries, canned goods, fresh produce, and daily necessities. A checkout counter sits near the entrance. B can usually be found here managing the store.

items.name: Cash Register
items.description: An old-fashioned cash register at the checkout counter.

items.name: Grocery Shelves
items.description: Neatly organized shelves with canned soup, rice, pasta, snacks, and beverages.

items.name: Fresh Produce Section
items.description: A small section with vegetables, fruits, and bread delivered daily.

conditions.description: Bright fluorescent lighting. A faint smell of fresh bread and cleaning products.
